tasks.label: check-specpress-link
tasks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='node_modules/specpress';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('ERROR: node_modules/specpress not found. Run: npm install');process.exit(1)}const s=fs.lstatSync(p);if(!s.isSymbolicLink()&&!fs.existsSync(p+'/lib/md2docx/md2docx.js')){console.error('ERROR: specpress appears broken.');process.exit(1)}const c=fs.readFileSync(p+'/lib/md2docx/md2docx.js','utf8');if(!c.includes('fileResolver')){console.warn('WARNING: node_modules/specpress is the npm version, not your local repo.');console.warn('Run co-develop.cmd to link your local specpress for development.')}else{console.log('OK: local specpress is linked.')}"
